You are one unit in a squad of 3 fighting 3 enemy units on a 32 by 32 map (x grows east, y grows
north). Every unit in your squad is a separate agent, like you: you control only your own unit, and the others
decide for themselves. You cannot see inside their heads; you only see their current orders and what they say
on team chat. Every half second of game time you give your unit one order:

  attack E<n>    shoot enemy E<n> when it is in range, otherwise walk toward it
  move <x> <y>   walk to a point without shooting
  hold           stand still and shoot the closest enemy in range
  retreat        walk away from the closest enemy without shooting

A unit dies at 0 health. The battle is won when every enemy is dead.
The enemy units each shoot the closest of you in range and keep shooting it until it dies.

Your squad coordinates through a Modality contract. Every half second the referee commits what it sees to
the contract, and then each unit's order counts only if a commit that writes it to /orders/<unit>.text,
signed with that unit's own key, is accepted. The contract refuses any commit that breaks one of its rules;
a refused unit keeps its last accepted order.

Contract rules (the squad wrote them after earlier battles; `modal` checks every order against them):
  1. A unit may commit an order of the form "attack E<n>" only if E<n> equals /world/focus.text, so that all living units in /team/units focus fire on the same enemy closest to the squad's centre instead of splitting targets or switching between E1 and E2.
     always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E0") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E0")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E1") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E1")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E2") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E2")] false)
  2. A unit may commit the order "hold", "move" or "retreat" only when its own /world/<A>/in_range.num is 0, so that any unit with an enemy in range must commit "attack" on /world/focus.text every half second instead of idling or splitting its fire.
     always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "hold") -num_eq(/world/$k/in_range.num, "0")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "move") -num_eq(/world/$k/in_range.num, "0")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "retreat") -num_eq(/world/$k/in_range.num, "0")] false)
  3. A unit may commit an order of the form "attack E<n>" only when /world/allies_alive.num is at least /world/enemies_alive.num, so the squad engages only when it is not outnumbered and does not trickle into a losing fight.
     always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E0") +num_lt(/world/allies_alive.num, /world/enemies_alive.num)] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E1") +num_lt(/world/allies_alive.num, /world/enemies_alive.num)] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E2") +num_lt(/world/allies_alive.num, /world/enemies_alive.num)] false)
Time: 2.5 seconds into the battle.
You are A2, a marine at (12.5, 14.9) with 45/45 health; you shoot up to 5 away and see up to 9 away. Your order now: hold.
Your team:
  A0 marine at (11.8, 14.5), 45/45 health, order: hold
  A1 marine at (12.3, 13.9), 45/45 health, order: hold
Enemies you can see:
  E0 marine at (17.2, 16.4), 45/45 health, 4.9 away (in range)
  E1 marine at (17.8, 16.8), 45/45 health, 5.6 away
  E2 marine at (17.8, 15.5), 45/45 health, 5.3 away
Team chat (most recent last):
  A1 (1.0s): A1 advancing to 12,15, staying grouped with A0 and A2.
  A2 (1.0s): A2 continuing to 12,15, staying grouped; focus fire on /world/focus.
  A0 (1.5s): A0 advancing to 12,15, grouped; will focus /world/focus when enemies appear.
  A1 (1.5s): Enemies E0, E2 east at 9 away. Hold grouped, focus /world/focus once in range.
  A2 (1.5s): Enemies 8+ away, none in range. Holding grouped; focus /world/focus when they close.
  A0 (2.0s): Holding grouped at 12,15; will attack /world/focus once enemies are in range.
  A1 (2.0s): No enemies in range yet. Holding grouped; all attack /world/focus once in range.
  A2 (2.0s): No enemy in range yet. Holding grouped; will attack /world/focus once they close.
Reply with JSON only: {"order": "<your order>", "say": "<optional: at most 15 words to your team>"}
